sources.title: Whitfield1894 On new forms of marine algae from the Trenton Limestone, PlateXI11-13
sources.notes: Original BulletinAMNH6:351-358 downloaded and read. PlateXI11 primary upright featherlike plume, little sideways plume on another shale layer NOT attached branch. Fig12 depicts whorls. Old isolated Fig13 joint/fork interpretation superseded by modern genus morphology; omitted. Ordovician Trenton Wisconsin not Silurian.

sources.title: LoDuca, Melchin and Verbruggen2011 Complex noncalcified macroalgae from the Silurian of Cornwallis Island
sources.notes: Original fulltext downloaded/read. Revised Chaetocladus architecture undivided cylindrical main axis and unbranched laterals in whorls; C.plumula remains cited from Ordovician Wisconsin. C.capitatus species measurements and enlargedcrown are NOT imported. Confirms correction to1894 putativeforks.
